text.tspan: Population growth rate, by level of development
Annual population change determined by births, deaths, and migration, expressed as a percentage of the
population. Future projections are based on the UN's medium scenario.
Data source: UN, World Population Prospects (2024)
Note: More developed regions comprise Europe, Northern America, Australia/New Zealand and Japan; less developed regions comprise all
regions of Africa, Asia (excluding Japan), Latin America and the Caribbean plus Melanesia, Micronesia and Polynesia; least developed countries
are 48 countries, 33 in Africa, 9 in Asia, 5 in Oceania plus one in Latin America and the Caribbean.
